title: #18 War of Ideas
prompt: 'In a war of ideas, it is people who get killed'. Does a common man suffer from a group’s ideology? Express your opinion and support the same with reasons and examples.

promptSegments.text: 'In a war of ideas, it is people who get killed'.
Does a common man suffer from a group’s ideology?
Express your opinion and support the same with reasons and examples.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how strong group ideas can hurt a person's life by forcing them to think in one way.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how strong group ideas can hurt a person's life by forcing them to think in one way.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that strong group ideas limit a person's ability to act, making them afraid to speak their minds.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The suffering of a common man is not caused by a group's strong ideas because personal choice allows people to maintain their own thoughts and live normally.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The suffering of a common man is not caused by a group's strong ideas because personal choice allows people to maintain their own thoughts and live normally.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Differences in thinking do not cause suffering because people can respect different views and maintain relationships despite disagreements.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how group ideologies force people to accept beliefs without questioning them, leading to damage to self-worth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how group ideologies force people to accept beliefs without questioning them, leading to damage to self-worth.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that ideologies limit a person's ability to see the world clearly by simplifying complex issues.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point explains that ideologies limit a person's ability to see the world clearly by simplifying complex issues.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that personal freedom and critical thinking protect individuals from the negative effects of group ideologies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that personal freedom and critical thinking protect individuals from the negative effects of group ideologies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that strong social bonds and mutual support are more vital to human well-being than adherence to any single belief system.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that strong social bonds and mutual support are more vital to human well-being than adherence to any single belief system.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
